BiblicalUsage: Jubal is the father of music. Genesis 4:21 says, "And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ." He is a son of Lamech, living before the flood, and his name stands at the head of every musician who follows.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe music is older than the flood, and Jubal is the proof. I hold that God gave music to a world that would soon drown, and that the harp and the organ in Genesis 4:21 show he meant beauty to be part of human life from the start.
